title: A genuinely mixed non-Gaussian cardinal product has strict finite-cutoff translation-Haar Fisher saving

witness.mixing_row: sum_j v_j^2=1 with at least two nonzero entries, hence sum_j v_j^4<1
witness.transformed_cumulant: kappa_4'=kappa_4(Y_t) sum_j v_j^4 differs from kappa_4(Y_t)

scope_guard: Strict finite-cutoff saving does not determine its leading scale and does not extend to Gaussian channels, pure coordinate permutations, correlated cumulant tensors or moving shapes without a new argument.
